events.title: Steam Next Fest Update: Leaderboards, Fixes & Improvements
events.summary: We’ve added Steam leaderboards! But please don’t feel you need to take them too seriously. We want Cash & Stash to be a relaxed, atmospheric experience you can enjoy at your own pace. The leaderboard is simply an optional challenge for repeat playthroughs, if you fancy another trip to the vault. Your time includes gameplay and inspecting money or dossiers. events.summary: https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/46298730/14e99818277afbd76b9348dbd5917b0432f47172.png The vault is open, and we’ve got a rather expensive mess for you to sort out. The Cash & Stash demo is now available on Steam! Step into a bank vault left in chaos after a heist.
